# Kapasiyahan Blg. 51, Serye ng Taong 2022

**Isang Kapasiyahang Nagpapatibay sa Takda ng Singil sa Masahe ng Pitogo Poctol Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (IPTODA) Inc. at Pitogo Burgos Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (PIBUTODA) at Iba Pang Kaugnay Nito**

_(Approving Fare Rates for Pitogo Tricycle Operators Associations -- IPTODA and PIBUTODA)_

> **MISFILED:** This document is Kapasiyahan Blg. 51, Serye ng Taong 2022, from the May 12, 2022 session. It is filed under the 2021/March folder but is actually Series of 2022. The source PDF filename (`img20231013_13530522.pdf`) is a scanned image file.

## Summary

Enacted on May 12, 2022 (misfiled in the 2021/March folder), this resolution with accompanying ordinance approves the fare rates for the [[Pitogo Poctol Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (IPTODA)|IPTODA]] Inc. and the [[Pitogo Burgos Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (PIBUTODA)|PIBUTODA]]. The ordinance establishes and regulates the fare schedule for tricycle transportation services operating on routes served by these two associations within the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].

## Key Provisions

1. **Fare Rate Approval**: Approves the fare rates (singil sa masahe) for tricycle services operated by IPTODA and PIBUTODA.

2. **IPTODA Routes**: Sets fare rates for the Pitogo-Poctol route and related areas served by the Pitogo Poctol Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association.

3. **PIBUTODA Routes**: Sets fare rates for the Pitogo-Burgos route and related areas served by the Pitogo Burgos Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association.

4. **Regulation**: Provides regulatory framework for tricycle fare collection and enforcement.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor, approved the ordinance
- [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]] — Vice Mayor/Presiding Officer
- [[Pitogo Poctol Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (IPTODA)|IPTODA]] — Pitogo Poctol Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association
- [[Pitogo Burgos Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (PIBUTODA)|PIBUTODA]] — Pitogo Burgos Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association
